//: Scoped typecheck for the UAT governance module.
Running the full backend `tsc` on this machine has repeatedly timed out and left
unkillable ~350MB orphan processes that starve the box. This config checks only
src/modules/uat-pipeline plus whatever it imports (tsc follows imports), which is
the part a change to this module can actually break, and it finishes in seconds.
It does NOT replace the full typecheck in CI — it is the fast local gate.
